extractions.tool: convert.py (this folder): the rep rows of results/uxd/report/runs.csv and results/uxdws/report/runs.csv (the latter is a second input, sha256 listed) grouped by setup, backend, model and effort: passed_of_n = passed rows / rows, quality_mean = mean of the quality column (2 decimals), cost_mean = mean of the cost column (4 decimals), tok_*_mean = means rounded to integers. Derived cells: the repo prints per-run rows only

convert.py (this folder): one row per rep row of results/uxd and results/uxdws report/runs.csv (in file order within each config, id = cell id + "#" + the row's order), with its quality cell unchanged
